# Activepieces MCP Workflow Cloud

Activepieces MCP Workflow Cloud is a SaaS workspace for Activepieces.

Website: https://activepiecesworkflow.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: Activepieces
Type: SaaS
Default plan: team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
